title: 6-Inch Solid Brass Towel Ring With Concealed Mount | Towel Rings | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop leaving hand towels on the counter—this compact towel ring keeps daily towels within easy reach while maintaining a clean, finished look in your bathroom.

  • Keep towels easy to grab with a 6-inch ring sized for decorative or everyday hand towels.
  • Built for everyday use with solid brass construction.
  • Clean wall presentation thanks to concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Coordinate matching pieces with the Towel Rings collection of versatile bath accessories.
  • Match your hardware with multiple designer finish options available.

Specs & Installation

  • Product type: Bathroom towel ring
  • Material: Solid brass
  • Mounting: Concealed screw, wall-mounted
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 6 x 6 x 6 inches
  • Box dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 6 x 4 inches
  • Shipping weight: 2 lbs
  • Assembled in the U.S.A.
